items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: (To the question) In the permanent Mochin of Atzilut, when Aba and Ima are in the stature of SAG, the VAK of the Hochma and Bina of BAN were divided between Aba and Ima: Aba took the VAK of the Hochma of BAN, and Ima took the VAK of the Bina of BAN. However, at the time of the ascent of Aba and Ima to the GAR of AA, and their attainment there of the stature of AB, by the bowing of the head of the GAR of Atik to the place of the GAR of AA, Ima attains there the GAR of the Hochma and Bina of BAN that Atik took; therefore also the VAK of the Hochma of BAN of Aba join to her, and she is entirely BAN, and Aba himself is entirely MAH. For the MAH of Ima joined to Aba, and the VAK of the Hochma of BAN of Aba joined to Ima. Thus, only in the stature of SAG of Aba and Ima does each of them have MAH and BAN. But from the stature of AB and above, Aba is found entirely MAH — the MAH of MAH and the MAH of BAN — and Ima is entirely BAN — the BAN of MAH and the BAN of BAN. (Item 140).
